stem: Why is 'wear as much PPE as possible' a weak general rule?
choices: PPE should match the assessed task and excessive or inappropriate PPE can create other hazards
More PPE always reduces dexterity but never safety
PPE is optional when engineering controls exist
Only supervisors need to understand PPE selection
rationale: PPE is selected for the assessed hazard and task. More is not automatically better and can create heat, visibility, dexterity, or other problems.
